spotlight.title: Matt launched his new site in less than 1 hour.
spotlight.paragraph1: From burning out on 12-hour gym shifts to running his own online coaching business, on his own terms.
spotlight.paragraph2: Matt had tried the agency route before. Thousands of dollars later, he had a terrible site and zero control over it.
spotlight.paragraph3: I showed him the right template. We sat in a café, he made the edits himself, and launched in 1 hour.
spotlight.highlightQuote: No design skills. No coding. Barely any laptop experience. Didn't need any.
